column3: With respect to the Durham Plaza Mortgage Loan (1.8%), the Mortgaged Property includes a stand-alone 22,500 square foot movie theater which was previously vacant, but was leased to Alvarez Entertainment Group, LLC (9.6% of net rentable area) on May 13, 2025, for use as a multi-purpose event space for private and public use, bar and/or lounge for a term of approximately 20 years. Given the condition of the movie theater building, it requires significant work to be rehabilitated to a structurally sound condition. At origination, $125,000 was reserved with the lender, which may be used either (i) to rehabilitate the building to a structurally sound condition with all life safety issues fully addressed or (ii) to demolish such building in a safe and lawful manner, removing all debris and restoring the site to a clean, level and buildable condition (the “Rehabilitation or Demolition”).
